details: Upcoming economic reports and Federal Reserve communications, including the release of meeting minutes and labor market data, are expected to introduce volatility to the cryptocurrency markets. The US stock market capitalization recently hit a record high of over $80 trillion.
title: Fed Minutes and Labor Data to Influence Crypto Markets

details: Market participants expect a low 21% probability of a Federal Reserve rate cut in 2026 due to strong economic indicators, such as Q1 2026 real GDP growth of 1.6%. Prolonged high interest rates typically deter growth in speculative risk assets like cryptocurrencies.
title: Low Probability of Fed Rate Cut in 2026 Amid Strong Economy

details: The U.S. government is reportedly exploring the framework for a Strategic Bitcoin Reserve, potentially overseen by the Treasury or Commerce Department. This integration could bring legitimacy, structural stability, and wider adoption to Bitcoin.
title: US Government Explores Strategic Bitcoin Reserve

details: Ripple has secured full MiCA CASP authorization from Luxembourg's CSSF, allowing the company to legally offer crypto-asset services across all 30 countries within the European Economic Area.
title: Ripple Secures MiCA Authorization for EEA Crypto Services

details: SpaceX, which holds Bitcoin, is set to join the Nasdaq 100 index on July 7th. This inclusion marks the company as the fourth member of the index with Bitcoin exposure, boosting institutional adoption sentiment.
title: SpaceX Joins Nasdaq 100, Highlights Bitcoin Exposure
